title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction; layouts and live previews may contain errors.

Settings: simplified colour controls, added Discord/Facebook/YouTube shortcuts, moved clan reward collection to general settings and revised European Portuguese labels. Sound bank diagnostics moved to general settings; technical loader options are hidden.

Live previews: corrected HUD zoom positioning, vehicle marker text offsets and font symbols, minimap images and vehicle classes, carousel samples and health bar previews. Scrolling updates after images load.

Hangar marks: restored the panel after a WNX import error; damage and rating colours follow the selected palette. WNX, WN8, win rate and the earned mastery icon appear horizontally with middle-dot separators.
Tech tree marks: removed the badge background and empty records; tiers I-IV show only an earned Ace Tanker, while higher tiers keep their available statistics.
Gun traverse limits: previews show the selected images; selecting no horizontal or vertical style disables the module.

Reload: manual reload (C by default) now sends only the native F8 command, with game-translated messages and minimap effects. Removed the custom reload message setting. Shell flight time keeps brace templates and older formats.

Target information: the target card now uses Gameface in standard battles; events without the Gameface HUD keep the Flash card. The vehicle image sits on its own line and armour/shell columns stay aligned (wider default tab stops).
Penetration indicator: the message now appears above the armour/penetration value; the ricochet label was removed from the default template.
Compatibility: Python 2.7 and World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Signed beta release; some visual changes still need confirmation in game.
